ths.text: Cilissa is brought to Setessa as an orphan at six, where Karametra's face appears in the stars and whispers that she is loved, and the goddess's sparks grow into glowing pods whose warmth brings back memories of her parents' fall to Akroan attackers. She grows up learning from Niketa, who teaches her that warriors fight with their minds, and from sparring with her friend Thora.

At eighteen she helps defend Setessa when Nyxborn invade in droves, and she kills the gorgon who turned Thora to stone, only to see her friends slain. Despairing, she lures a minotaur into cleaving open one of Karametra's pods, which dissolves all the Nyxborn.
Years later Cilissa welcomes a new group of orphaned children into the same clearing with Karametra's voice, telling them they are safe and home.
